primary_route: ATP/marker-size angular periodicity and inhibitor/product perturbations; torque consistency without work/free-energy or direct turnover counting.

checks.reason: No explicit proposal to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated protocol for detailed pre-execution conditions and transfer. Recording unknown settings and developing an assay locally do not satisfy this distinct requirement.

The core immobilization/shaft attachment, solution chemistry (including nucleotide/free-magnesium conditions), recording settings and load manipulation lack an executable quantitative workflow or a concrete calibration-to-setting procedure. Lists of parameters to select later are insufficient.

Correct independent-preparation/chamber/molecule hierarchy is present, but the sample-size pilot does not specify a quantitative precision/power target linked to meaningful effect and between-preparation variance.
Eligibility requires sustained motion and no original inactive/irregular denominator is retained; aborting a coverslip with >30% exclusions can remove biological load-dependent failure.
Primary estimands and hierarchical/held-out comparisons are present, but exact model assumptions/diagnostics and multiplicity control for the several primary load/coupling/event tests are incomplete.

Pooling angle occupancy and testing only prespecified 120/40-degree periodicities does not distinguish actual steps from smooth angle-dependent velocity or orientation artifacts. The second detector is useful but no full continuous-motion null validates this decision.

ATP/load/acquisition optimization is not bounded by an explicit ladder or objective range-derivation/search-stop rule before the lock. A promise to select a spanning range from pilots is not a fully specified exploration policy.
Pilot separation and troubleshooting are described, but technical changes do not explicitly trigger a revised freeze and fresh independent confirmatory data under a defined change-control policy.
ATP-dependent waiting plus analog arrest does not count one binding event per mechanical step. The positive claim asserts this linkage while its own caveat concedes chemical counting is absent.
No complete preserved raw-unit-to-output manifest with exact analysis versions/settings, calibration records and failed/excluded-unit logs is specified.

Three independent substantive errors: (1) binding-limited mean waiting time is inverse, not linear decreasing, in ATP (the later inverse statement does not resolve the contradictory prediction); (2) an 80+40-degree split produces alternating 80/40 intervals, not uniformly 40-degree-spaced occupancy peaks; (3) fixed-torque rate is inversely drag-limited at high drag and plateaus from chemistry at low drag, contrary to the stated inverse-until-drag-limited-plateau logic.

A Brownian ratchet is not identified by continuous occupancy or absence of dwells; ratchets can generate tightly coupled discrete steps. The primary mechanism partition needs a physical kinetic discriminator beyond smooth-versus-stepped traces.
